localizer_source_note: release/v1.13.0: main at d771c6f plus the version bump in package.xml and CMakeLists.txt (the version is not compiled in), built and replayed from the working tree before the release commit, which adds only docs and this evidence to that tree
localizer_build: colcon build --symlink-install --packages-up-to lidar_localization_ros2, no CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE (as in AGENTS.md), MAKEFLAGS=-j2, ccache off, in the release workspace rebuilt from scratch (its build, install and log directories had been deleted); lidar_localization_node is relinked, as the localizer source changed since v1.12.0 (the registration, per-scan tracking and local re-acquisition moved into lidar_localization_core; the opt-in map-distance prefilter and agreement release); ndt_omp_ros2 also without a build type (it defaults to Release); bbs3d_cpp, bbs_cpp and g2_ndt_score were built
localizer_library_check: AMENT_PREFIX_PATH held only the release workspace and /opt/ros/jazzy; ldd resolved liblidar_localization_component.so to the release workspace's install; ndt_omp is linked statically
ndt_omp_source_note: humble at 17ce1e1, the same commit as for v1.11.0 and v1.12.0 (dependencies.repos still names the humble branch): the 0.2.0 release (9f5567e) plus PCL 1.10 / ROS 2 Foxy build support (#18). humble gained 5a207b1 (PCL 1.15 build: include the Boost headers directly) on 2026-11-28, not used here

same_host_comparison.note: Alignment and CPU were lower than in v1.12.0's check on the same CPU model, so v1.12.0 (6f6cf9a) was rebuilt on this host in a scratch workspace with the same flags but BUILD_TESTING=OFF (localizer sha256 0ba033a645021c9183d0620fe90234085bef2d6f4b5186bfb6f54d60ddd056a1, on the same ndt_omp_ros2 install; ldd resolved its component to that workspace) and replayed twice, interleaved with two more replays of the release build (v1.12.0, v1.13.0, v1.12.0, v1.13.0). The extra runs are not in evidence.tar.gz.

previous_release.note: the same RKO binary, RKO and QoS configuration, profile, ndt_omp_ros2 commit, container type and CPU model; a different localizer executable (the source changed)

notes: Full public sequence at 1x, one cloud container, ROS 2 Jazzy, 4 vCPUs, the same RKO binary as v1.6.0 to v1.12.0. localizer.yaml, rko.yaml and points-qos.yaml are byte-identical to v1.12.0's; the receipts differ only in the localizer hash. Same CPU model as v1.12.0's check, but alignment took 16-17 ms at the median and 41 ms at p95 against 18 ms and 44-46 ms; v1.12.0 rebuilt and replayed on this host measured 16 ms and 40-42 ms (same_host_comparison), so the difference is the host, not the release. The release check runs the localizer with the Koide profile, not quickstart, so the quickstart defaults with odometry prediction (window guard, 1.5 m NMS, near-alias, agreement release) and the opt-in map-distance prefilter are not exercised.
